height_source: ARRChaser capsule 24 x 62 half height (Source/RogueRigs/Enemies/RRChaser.cpp InitCapsuleSize(24, 62)) = 124 cm; bp-chaser BodyMesh 124 uu centred on the capsule; model from the sole to the top of the cap
axes: forward +X, robot left +Y, up +Z; _L parts at +Y

decal.uv: UVMap (UV0) 0..1 on the logo quad only, other faces collapsed to (0,0)

warnings: eye_red is emissive in Blender (strength 4, #FF1010): the FBX does not carry emission, the Unreal material sets the glow

fidelity.method: Orthographic renders at the scale of the crops (same sole row, same px per cm), opened together with the matching crop (Read) in side-by-side composites compare_<view>.png; silhouettes: crop mask (yellow or dark pixels, closed) vs render mask (differs from the uniform background); the render is shifted horizontally by the best IoU shift (front +1 px, side 0, back +3 px) and the largest difference is the Chebyshev Hausdorff distance between the two filled silhouettes, in percent of the crop height.

silhouette_difference_pct_H.note: IoU is lowered by the crop mask holes (bright facets) and the curled hands; the Hausdorff maximum sits at the hands and at the foot toes.

C1.evidence: Block+cap z 0.655..1.0 H = 34.5 % H tall, 24 % H wide (29.8 cm), depth 34 % H at the hood apex (crop side measures 34 % at the apex, 28 % at z 0.70; the criterion text says about 29 %: judged against the crop), cap box on top (width 17 % H at its base), front leans like a hood (apex z 0.84, upper face leans back to the cap, lower face leans back to the bottom), block extends backwards. Side composite overlays within 2 % H.

C2.evidence: Dark recess 62 % of the block width (3.5 cm deep) in the lower half (z 0.69..0.78 H) with a red emissive octagon (6.4 cm across, centred); above it the logo decal (yellow plate, dark shield, yellow star glyph; 7.4 cm = 25 % of the block width) centred. The criterion says recess about 45 %: the crop measures 69 % (117 of 170 px) so 62 % follows the crop; if the owner wants the 45 % text, set RS in the script.

C3.evidence: Gunmetal pelvis 13.5 % H wide at the top narrowing to 8.5 % (narrower than the block, 24 %), 7.7 % H tall plus a yellow lower rim 3.2 % H (total 10.4 % H, crop 9.8 %), the rim visible in front view.

C4.evidence: Outer-to-outer arm span 68.3 % H (crop 69 %); upper arm 10 % H wide at the top, wider at the top than at the elbow, dark elbow connector, forearm 9 % H, dark hand with palm and three two-segment finger blocks curled forward and inward; elbow bend as drawn (shoulder x 0.196 to elbow 0.243 to wrist 0.293 H); hands end at 55.5 % H below the top (crop 55 %), slightly forward (X +4 to +9 cm) in the side view.

C5.evidence: Pelvis bottom to sole 55.8 % H (crop 56 %); thigh yellow box 8 to 9 % H wide in front view (crop measures 8 to 9 %; the criterion says about 12 %: judged against the crop), dark octagonal knee prism (r 4.2 cm, axis lateral) visible in side view, shin box 8.5 to 6.5 % H wide, dark leg bars visible between the yellow boxes in front view, legs straight and parallel, outer foot edges 41 % H apart (crop 43 %). The crop legs splay slightly outward; the model keeps them parallel as the criterion asks.

C6.evidence: Yellow foot (toe wedge, instep guard, heel) on a dark sole with two dark toe blocks (front slanted) and a dark heel block, 23 % H long (crop 23.5 %), 15 % H tall at the heel (crop about 17 %), pointing forward (+X).

C7.evidence: Yellow on block, cap, upper arms, forearms, hip guards, thighs, shins, instep and feet; gunmetal on pelvis, shoulder and elbow connectors, hands, upper leg bars, knee prisms, ankle, soles, toe and heel blocks; eye_red only on the eye octagon; logo_plate only on the decal; four slots yellow_body, gunmetal, eye_red, logo_plate on every part; no other colour in the renders.

C8.evidence: Exactly 10 objects named HeadTorso, Pelvis, UpperArm_L/R, ForearmHand_L/R, Thigh_L/R, ShinFoot_L/R; pivots at the joints (joints_cm in the report); hierarchy Pelvis > HeadTorso > UpperArm > ForearmHand and Pelvis > Thigh > ShinFoot; interpenetration between each parent and child measured with BVH ray parity: at most 0.87 cm (limit 1 cm).

C9.evidence: Large flat facets, flat shading, no panel lines, bolts or cables, no cylinder except the two knee prisms (ankle is a box, the crop shows an octagon there), total 1632 tris (ceiling 3000).

C10.evidence: Largest silhouette difference: front 3.37 % H, side 3.12 % H, back 3.63 % H (limit 5 %); top and sole rows coincide (0.3 % and 0 %). Row edge tables (outer arm edges, leg edges, foot edges, block edges) agree within about 2 % H except the shoulder connectors in front view (+2 to 4 % H in the crop).

still_differs: The crop has more and finer facets than the model (rounded hexagonal upper arms, thigh and shin guards, curled thumbs on the hands): the model is a coarser version of the same shapes.
The crop legs splay slightly outward (hip 0.09, knee 0.11, foot 0.15 of H from the centre line); the model legs are parallel (C5).
The foot is a simplified wedge: the crop has an octagonal ankle prism and slanted side plates; the ankle here is a box (C9: no cylinders except the knees).
Hip guards are plain boxes beside the pelvis; the crop shows rounded plates.
The back of the block is a plain slab; the crop back has several plates (small panel lines are forbidden by C9).
The glow and halo of the eye are not rendered in Blender (Unreal glow); the decal on the upper face shows a faint plate outline because plate and face share the same yellow.
Hands: palm plus three curled finger blocks, no thumb (the crop hand shows a thumb).

criteria_text_vs_crop.recess_width: criterion about 45 % of block width, crop measures 69 %, model 62 %
criteria_text_vs_crop.block_depth: criterion about 29 %, crop 34 % at the apex
criteria_text_vs_crop.thigh_width: criterion about 12 % H, crop 8 to 9 % H

refinement.method: Same as step 03 (orthographic front, side, back renders at the scale of the crops, compare_<view>.png = crop | render | silhouette overlay, Hausdorff distance in percent of crop height), plus four orthographic close-ups (hand front, hand side, calf front, calf side) at 22 cm / 44 cm windows, each composed next to the same window cut from the crop (compare_closeup_*.png) and opened and judged.

tris.note: 2056 used; the spare 540 below the aimed 2600 is left unused: all criteria except the back plate contrast are met and the triangle budget is a ceiling

refinement.changed_calves: ShinFoot rebuilt: the thin shin box, the floating ankle block and the separate instep box are replaced by ONE continuous faceted shin guard of five octagonal sections from the knee (z 44 cm) to the ankle (z 23 cm), 12.3 cm deep at the widest (the sheet: about 12.5 cm), tapering to 5.4 cm; a dark octagonal ankle prism (r 3.6 cm) at z 13.3 cm between shin and foot, a dark neck behind it, the dark leg bar kept in front of the shin and extended to the ankle, a slanted yellow instep shield and two ankle cheek plates, a heel profile with a slanted top; reason: the side crop shows one deep tapering shin guard over a dark octagonal ankle joint, not a thin box with a block floating at the ankle.
refinement.changed_hands: ForearmHand rebuilt: the rectangular mitt with three straight finger blocks is replaced by a dark wrist ring, a narrower faceted palm (5.8 cm wide, 10 cm deep, 8.6 cm tall), three fingers of two segments each side by side in depth (as the side crop shows them) hooking inward (about 3 cm toward the body) and forward (about 3 cm), and a two-segment thumb on the inner side hooking down and forward; reason: the crops show curled claws, a palm narrower than the old mitt in front view and fingers lined up along the depth axis.
refinement.changed_other: HeadTorso: chamfered top edge of the hood, three-step rounded shoulder line, three raised back plates (centre plate with two facets, two outward plates), logo plate in a lighter yellow (#FFD84A) with a dark frame and a larger dark shield and star in T_ChaserLogo.png; UpperArm: faceted, narrow top, wide shoulder cap (14 cm), taper to the elbow; ForearmHand: forearm 1 cm wider, a guard plate on the front face; Thigh: faceted knee guard (four sections), chamfered hip guard plates; Pelvis: chamfered yellow rim; ShinFoot: foot 16 cm wide, two angled toe blocks 5.2 cm wide at the outer sides, heel block, foot 30 cm long (24 % H) and 18.6 cm (15 % H) tall at the heel.

C1.evidence: Block 0.655..1.0 H, 24 % H wide, hood front with chamfered top edge, cap box; side compare within 2.7 % H; the back face moved 1.6 cm forward and the back plates restore the depth.

C2.evidence: Dark recess with the red octagon unchanged in the lower half; logo plate above it, centred, now a lighter yellow with a dark frame and a large dark shield (compare_front).

C3.evidence: Dark pelvis block with a chamfered yellow rim visible in front view, narrower than the block.

C4.evidence: Shoulder-to-shoulder 85.2 cm = 68.7 % H (crop 69 %); upper arms wider at the cap, dark elbow connector, forearm, dark hand; hands end at z 54.4 cm = 56 % H from the top (target 55 %).

C5.evidence: Legs straight with the same stance; feet 43 % H apart outer to outer (crop 45 %), dark bars visible between the yellow parts in front view.

C6.evidence: Foot 24 % H long, 15 % H tall at the heel, dark sole, two angled dark toe blocks and a dark heel block (compare_side, closeup_calf_side).

C7.evidence: Yellow on block, arms, thighs, shins, feet; gunmetal on pelvis, joints, hands, soles, bars; red only on the eye; four slots unchanged.

C8.evidence: Ten objects, same names, pivots, hierarchy and joints; largest joint penetration 0.87 cm.

C9.evidence: Large flat facets, flat shading, no bolts or panel lines; only the knee and ankle prisms are octagonal cylinders.

C10.evidence: Hausdorff 3.09 % H front, 2.72 % side, 3.35 % back (limit 5 %); the largest differences sit at the hand tips, the foot toes and the upper arms in back view.

C11.evidence: closeup_calf_side and compare_side: one continuous tapering yellow shin guard knee to ankle, 12.3 cm deep (sheet about 12.5), dark octagonal ankle between shin and foot, no floating block; closeup_calf_front: dark leg bar in front of the shin as on the sheet. Differs: the sheet instep shield overlaps the ankle octagon from the front, here the shield and cheek plates sit beside it.

C12.evidence: closeup_hand_front and closeup_hand_side: narrower palm, three fingers (two segments) and a thumb hooking inward and forward, the claw curls toward the thigh in side view. Differs: the sheet fingers are slightly thicker and shorter, the thumb slightly shorter.

C13.evidence: Geometry present (hood chamfer, rounded shoulder, three back plates, cap, recess and eye kept) but in compare_back the three plates read only faintly because the plates differ by 10 to 18 degrees in normal and the renderer has no ambient occlusion; the sheet plates are more distinct. Not corrected after 5 returns.

C14.evidence: Faceted upper arms with a wide cap, forearms with a front guard plate, elbow bend kept (compare_front, compare_side).

C15.evidence: Faceted knee guard and shin, chamfered hip guard plates; splay kept: knee 12.5 % H, foot 14.5 % H from the centre line (crop 11 % and 15 %), hip guard plates replace the plain boxes.

C16.evidence: Feet 16 cm wide (13 % H), two angled toe blocks and a heel block, 24 % H long and 15 % H tall at the heel; logo plate lighter yellow with dark frame, visible contrast with the block in compare_front.

C17.evidence: 2056 triangles (aimed 2600, ceiling 3000), flat shading, cylinders only at the knee and ankle.

assembly.method: assemble.py from the six part modules; orthographic renders at the crop scale, silhouette Hausdorff distance after best horizontal alignment (as step 03)
assembly.contract_fix: KNEE y 0.125 H -> 0.11 H (15.5 -> 13.64 cm) in common.py; ShinFoot shifted inward by 1.86 cm at the knee, tapering linearly to 0 at z 22 cm (ankle/foot keep the sheet position, outer foot edge unchanged); Part got dy/dz arguments for this shift; Thigh unchanged
assembly.joint_gap: none seen in the closeups; knee, hip, shoulder, elbow, ankle overlap by 0 to 0.93 cm
still_differs: hands: one finger block merged into the palm, the sheet shows three separate chunky fingers
HeadTorso back plates read weakly (a bulge behind the head on the three-quarter view, little in the back view)
ShinFoot foot has fewer facet steps than the sheet; a small gap under the foot arch between the foot upper and the toe block in side view
the shin leans inward from the ankle to the knee (about 1.9 cm over 22 cm) to meet the thigh knee axis at 0.11 H
back view: arms hang about 1 to 2 percent of H narrower than the sheet at the hands (the sheet is asymmetric)
